definitions.explanation: From a specific point in the past until now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{以来|いらい}、⟦{会|あ}っていない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I haven't seen them since graduation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧{以来|いらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: It's the first time since last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧{以来|いらい}だ。
examples.english: It's the first time since I was a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{以来|いらい}、⟦{幸|しあわ}せです→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧。
examples.english: I've been happy since getting married.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧{以来|いらい}、⟦{禁煙|きんえん}します→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧。
examples.english: From today onwards, I'll quit smoking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧{以来|いらい}、ずっと⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧だ。
examples.english: We've been friends ever since we met.

examples.japanese: これ{以来|いらい}、⟦{注意|ちゅうい}する→注意：01464_chuui⟧ようにしている。
examples.english: From then on, I've been careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{以来|いらい}10⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been 10 years since I joined the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{以来|いらい}、⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{合|あ}おう→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Let's keep in touch from now on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{以来|いらい}、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}していない→運転：01335_unten⟧。
examples.english: I haven't driven since the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧{以来|いらい}、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}に→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}する→行動：02728_koudou⟧ように⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Since this failure, I've started acting more carefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧{以来|いらい}、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けている→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: Since last month, I've been exercising every day.

notes:
{以来|いらい} indicates "since" a specific time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X{以来|いらい} (since X)
- 〜て{以来|いらい} (since doing ~)
- {以来|いらい}ずっと (ever since then)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {以来|いらい}: since (continuing until now)
- {以後|いご}: after, from then on (forward-looking)
- {以降|いこう}: from ~ onward (often written)

NOTE:
- Different from {依頼|いらい} (request) - same reading, different kanji
